subject: how to load csv file inside the global.r for shiny

messages.author: 40a63e579feba2c0
messages.subject: how to load csv file inside the global.r for shiny
parts:
Hello All,


I'm new to Shiny, and I have a question regarding opening the data that been imported inside global.r:

My row data is in a .csv file and I did import it to Shiny through the global.r file using "read.csv()" then I did some data manipulation using the dplyr package and my data name now is "cellMapData".
==> All of this been done inside global.r.

Now when I run the App, all of above works great but Shiny keep give me an error about my data ""cellMapData"" saying that 

""""Error in func() : could not find function "cellMapData"""" 

Files are attached.

Appreciate your advice in advance.



Kind regards.

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: how to load csv file inside the global.r for shiny
parts:
You're trying to call cellMapData as a function in your server.R--just remove the parentheses.

You only need the parentheses for function calls, and for accessing the values of reactive expressions.

cellMapData <- data.frame(...)
plot(cellMapData)

rCellMapData <- reactive({ cellMapData })
plot(rCellMapData())
